clips.label: Raised phone
clips.description: Phone held up toward the screen for at least the piracy threshold.
clips.notes: Record at the auditorium seat. Keep the wrist above the shoulder for the full threshold.

clips.label: Quick glance
clips.description: Phone is checked for about a second, then lowered.
clips.notes: The timer should decay before PIRACY_ALERT.

clips.label: Eating popcorn
clips.description: Hand moves to the mouth, as if eating.
clips.notes: Wrist stays near the nose. This is eating_like, not a recording pose.

clips.label: Arms raised
clips.description: Both arms go up briefly and come back down.
clips.notes: A brief two-arm raise is stretching_like and must not alert.
